title: EmboTeam: Asymmetric State Grounding for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2601.11063v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Heterogeneous multi-robot collaboration over long horizons requires both global task planning and robust coordination during execution. Existing plan- ners using large language models (LLMs) can generate task decompositions or symbolic plans, but often execute them as rigid action sequences, making them fragile to local state mismatches and synchronization failures. We propose Em- boTeam, a neuro-symbolic framework for asymmetric state grounding. An LLM generates structured state expectations, which are verified and coordinated through symbolic search using Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) and then grounded into a team-level parallel behavior tree. Robot-specific subtrees per- form precondition checking, skill execution, effect validation, local replanning, and blackboard-based synchronization. translated_title: EmboTeam：面向异构多机器人协作的非对称状态接地
translated_abstract: 面向长时程的异构多机器人协作既需要全局任务规划，也需要执行过程中的鲁棒协调。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划器能够生成任务分解或符号化规划，但往往将其作为僵硬的动作序列执行，导致其对局部状态不匹配和同步失败十分脆弱。我们提出 EmboTeam，一个用于非对称状态接地的神经符号框架。LLM 生成结构化的状态预期，这些预期通过基于规划领域定义语言（PDDL）的符号搜索进行验证与协调，随后被落地为团队级的并行行为树。针对各机器人的子树负责前置条件检查、技能执行、效果验证、局部重规划以及基于黑板机制的同步。我们进一步提出了 MACE-THOR 基准，包含跨 8 种室内布局的 42 个异构多机器人任务。EmboTeam 提升了任务的……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出 EmboTeam 神经符号框架，通过 LLM 生成结构化状态预期、PDDL 符号搜索验证协调，并落地为带局部重规划与黑板同步的团队级并行行为树，实现异构多机器人长时程协作中的非对称状态接地，显著提升执行鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: EmboTeam is a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds LLM-generated structured state expectations via PDDL-based symbolic search into a team-level parallel behavior tree with local replanning and blackboard synchronization, enabling robust asymmetric state grounding for heterogeneous multi-robot collaboration over long horizons.
